title: Climbing Stairs
keyIdea: ways(i) = ways(i − 1) + ways(i − 2): the last move onto step i is 1 step or 2 steps. Base ways(1) = 1, ways(2) = 2. Only the last two values matter, so two variables give O(1) space.

approaches.name: Memoization (top-down)
approaches.idea: memo(n) = memo(n − 1) + memo(n − 2), cached in dp so each value is computed once.
approaches.why: n distinct subproblems, each O(1) once cached; dp array plus recursion stack.

approaches.name: Two variables (bottom-up)
approaches.idea: prev2 = 1, prev1 = 2; for i = 3..n: curr = prev1 + prev2, slide forward.
approaches.why: One pass, keeping only the two values the recurrence reads.

options: The last move onto step i is either 1 step from i − 1 or 2 steps from i − 2, and these never overlap
